programme.title: Hotel Artemis
programme.desc: As rioting rocks Los Angeles in the year 2028, disgruntled thieves make their way to Hotel Artemis -- a 13-story, members-only hospital for criminals. It's operated by the Nurse, a no-nonsense, high-tech healer who already has her hands full with a French assassin, an arms dealer and an injured cop. As the violence of the night continues, the Nurse must decide whether to break her own rules and confront what she's worked so hard to avoid.

programme.title: Black Snake Moan
programme.desc: After her lover (Justin Timberlake) leaves to serve in the military, Rae (Christina Ricci) gives in to her raging libido and leaps into a life of wild abandon. Lazarus (Samuel L. Jackson), a troubled bluesman, finds Rae beaten and left for dead. He takes her in and holds her captive in an attempt to help her find a cure for her affliction.

programme.title: Captive
programme.desc: Brian Nichols (David Oyelowo) becomes the subject of a citywide manhunt after breaking out of a courthouse jail and killing four people. His frantic escape brings him to the apartment of Ashley Smith (Kate Mara), a single mother and recovering methamphetamine addict. Held hostage by Nichols in her own home, the scared woman looks for guidance from "The Purpose Driven Life," Rick Warren's best-selling, inspirational book. As she reads aloud, Ashley and her would-be killer come to a crossroad.

programme.title: V for Vengeance
programme.desc: After learning that their younger sibling escaped an earlier kidnapping attempt that also killed their parents, two estranged sisters must join forces to rescue her from a group of bloodthirsty vampires. Out for revenge and control of a vampirism vaccine, Thorn and his band of the undead soon learn that they messed with the wrong family.

programme.title: The Painter
programme.desc: An ex-CIA operative is tracked down by a young woman and they become entangled in an unauthorized black ops program.

programme.title: Breathe
programme.desc: Maya and her young daughter, Zora, are forced to live underground when Earth is left uninhabitable due to a lack of oxygen. When a mysterious couple arrive and claim to know the fate of Maya's husband, she tentatively agrees to let them into the bunker. However, mother and daughter soon find themselves in a fight for survival when the truth about the strangers comes to light.

programme.title: Paycheck
programme.desc: Michael Jennings is a top-notch reverse engineer. Corporations pay him to crack the secrets of their competitors' products. When the job is done, he has his memory of it erased. Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: Soon after moving into a suburban tract home, Katie (Katie Featherston) and Micah (Micah Sloat) become increasingly disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence. Hoping to capture evidence of it on film, they set up video cameras in the house but are not prepared for the terrifying events that follow.

programme.title: Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back
programme.desc: When Jay and Silent Bob learn that a Bluntman and Chronic movie is being made featuring their comic book counterparts, they drool at the thought of fat movie checks rolling in. But when the pair find that there won't be any royalties coming their way, they set out to sabotage the flick at all costs.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Last Movie
programme.desc: Cheech Marin and Tommy Chong discuss their lifelong friendship and popularity as a comedic duo. Features interviews, sketches and never-before-seen footage spanning their five-decade career.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong Still Smokin'
programme.desc: Stoners Cheech and Chong reunite and head to Amsterdam for a film festival after getting tickets from a promoter in L.A. When they show up at a celebrity party, Cheech is mistaken for Burt Reynolds, and Chong for Dolly Parton. The duo rolls with it as they roll more joints, partake in the usual antics and eat every item -- which include a lot of mushrooms -- on the menu at Amsterdam's Bvlgar Café.

programme.title: Erotic Alien Encounter
programme.desc: A humanoid alien named David gets stranded on Earth and is befriended by a beautiful nurse named Kate. With help from her best friend, Kate is determined to help David return to his home planet before government agents get to him first.

programme.title: Changeland
programme.desc: A man meets up with his best friend in Thailand while going through a personal crisis.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Gilbert Grape (Johnny Depp) is a small-town young man with a lot of responsibility. Chief among his concerns are his mother (Darlene Cates), who is so overweight that she can't leave the house, and his mentally impaired younger brother, Arnie (Leonardo DiCaprio), who has a knack for finding trouble. Settled into a job at a grocery store and an ongoing affair with local woman Betty Carver (Mary Steenburgen), Gilbert finally has his life shaken up by the free-spirited Becky (Juliette Lewis).

programme.title: Camp X-Ray
programme.desc: A female guard at Guantánamo Bay forms an unlikely friendship with one of the facility's longtime detainees.

programme.title: Bang Bang
programme.desc: Following Bang Bang Rozyski, an eccentric retired pugilist obsessed with rectifying the sins of his past.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: A comet is hurtling toward Earth and could mean the end of all human life. The U.S. government keeps the crisis under wraps, but crack reporter Jenny Lerner (Tea Leoni) uncovers the truth -- forcing U.S. President Beck (Morgan Freeman) to announce his plan. Grizzled astronaut Spurgeon "Fish" Tanner (Robert Duvall) and his team will land on the comet and lay explosives, hopefully deterring the object from its doomsday course. If not, humanity will have to prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji (Michael Wincott) commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In this quartet of neo-noir tales, a mysterious salesman (Josh Hartnett) narrates a tragic story of co-dependency, while a musclebound vigilante (Mickey Rourke) tears his way through the criminal underworld in search of his lost love (Jaime King). In another part of the city, a grizzled cop (Bruce Willis) foils the ambitions of a child-killer (Nick Stahl), and an ex-prostitute (Brittany Murphy) evades her ex-pimp (Benicio Del Toro) with the help of her new boyfriend, Dwight (Clive Owen).

programme.title: Maniac
programme.desc: A serial killer (Elijah Wood) removes his victims' scalps and attaches them to the vintage mannequins he restores in his late mother's shop.

programme.title: Wrong Turn
programme.desc: Despite warnings to stick to the Appalachian Trail, hikers stray off course and cross into land inhabited by a hidden community of mountain dwellers who use deadly means to protect their way of life. Suddenly under siege, the friends seem headed to the point of no return -- unless one man can reach them in time.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 2
programme.desc: When the Reys move into their new Southern California home, little do they realize that the house is already occupied. After coming home one day to find the house in disarray -- but with no signs of forced entry or robbery -- they install a video surveillance system to catch the perpetrators. But nothing prepares them for what happens next.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 3
programme.desc: A videographer becomes obsessed with finding the source of disturbing late-night noises in his home and discovers its terrifying origin.

programme.title: Hard Rain
programme.desc: The small town of Huntingburg is forced to evacuate when torrential rains bring rising floodwaters. The local sheriff and town residents, having been through this before, are all too familiar with the looting and petty thefts that take place in an abandoned town. What they are not aware of, however, is the planned heist of an armored car sent to transport the $3 million from local banks.

programme.title: Drillbit Taylor
programme.desc: For three misfit freshmen, the first day of high school becomes a living hell when Filkins (Alex Frost), the school bully, zeroes in on them. Chubby Ryan (Troy Gentile), diminutive Emmit (David Dorfman) and skinny Wade (Nate Hartley) all feel the wrath of Filkins. Realizing that their own chance for survival is to hire a bodyguard, the pals place an ad in the newspaper. Answering the call is Drillbit Taylor (Owen Wilson) ; armed, dangerous and completely fake.

programme.title: Dean
programme.desc: An illustrator falls in love with a woman while trying to keep his father from burning down the family home after his wife dies.

programme.title: Superstar
programme.desc: Orphaned after the death of her parents and raised by her strict grandmother (Glynis Johns), awkward Roman Catholic high-school student Mary Katherine Gallagher (Molly Shannon) dreams about dating popular student Sky Corrigan (Will Ferrell) and becoming a star. To achieve both goals, Mary enters a talent contest, where her competitor is Sky's girlfriend, Evian Graham (Elaine Hendrix). Despite her grandmother's opposition, Mary prepares to win both the contest and Sky's affection.

programme.title: Jersey Girl
programme.desc: Ollie Trinke is young and at the top of his game as a music promoter. He is both a workaholic and a silver-tongued expert at manipulating the press. At a company Christmas party, Ollie meets Gertrude Stein, a book editor for a New York publishing house. They are instantly attracted to each other, and begin a whirlwind romance that changes the course of his personal and professional life.

programme.title: Hitsville: The Making of Motown
programme.desc: Motown Records becomes the most successful label of all time after its formation in 1958 Detroit amid racial tension and the burgeoning civil rights movement.

programme.title: The Longshots
programme.desc: Curtis Plummer (Ice Cube), a down-on-his-luck former football player, becomes the new coach of the Minden, Illinois, Pop Warner football team. With his niece Jasmine (Keke Palmer) installed as the team's quarterback and secret weapon, Curtis has a chance to turn his life around, while the residents of Minden have a chance to recapture their team spirit and civic pride.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: A renegade Vulcan makes Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and the Enterprise go to a planet at the center of the galaxy.

programme.title: The Queen
programme.desc: Following the death of Princess Diana in an auto accident, Great Britain's Queen Elizabeth II (Helen Mirren) and Prime Minister Tony Blair (Michael Sheen) struggle to reach a compromise in how the royal family should publicly respond to the tragedy. In the balance is the family's need for privacy and the public's demand for an outward show of mourning.

programme.title: Anything for Fame
programme.desc: Venturing into the virtual Wild West to profile a new breed of content creator.

programme.title: The To Do List
programme.desc: It's 1993, and high-school valedictorian Brandy Klark decides she needs to shed her uptight image before college. She puts together a list of all the activities -- including sex -- she missed in high school. When she soon realizes she is out of her depth, Brandy enlists the aid of her friends, older sister, and boss. Summer marches on, and members of the group realize that they will need plenty of imagination and open mindedness to complete her project before September.

programme.title: Boudica: Queen of War
programme.desc: Roman conquerors slay King Prasutagus, take away his children, and force his wife, Boudica, into subservience. Consumed by grief and a burning desire for justice, Boudica vows to reclaim her homeland from the clutches of the Romans. She soon leads her army in a desperate assault as the fate of her people and her own destiny hang in the balance.

programme.title: An Inconvenient Truth
programme.desc: Filmmaker Davis Guggenheim follows Al Gore on the lecture circuit, as the former presidential candidate campaigns to raise public awareness of the dangers of global warming and calls for immediate action to curb its destructive effects on the environment.

programme.title: Lift
programme.desc: A remarkable ballet program enables homeless children to discover the magic of self-expression through dance.

programme.title: Loosies
programme.desc: A young pickpocket in the New York subways who is living a fast and free lifestyle is confronted by a woman with whom he had a one-night stand. She informs him that she is now pregnant with his child. He must now make a choice.

programme.title: Nothing Lasts Forever
programme.desc: The DeBeers diamond cartel corners the market on love with the "A diamond is forever" catchphrase, but a wave of undetectable synthetic diamonds floods global gem markets, threatening to expose the artifice behind a multi-billion dollar industry. Featuring interviews with diamond merchants, DeBeers execs, auctioneers, gemologists, designers, investigators and scientists.

programme.title: Ella Enchanted
programme.desc: As a baby, Ella (Anne Hathaway) receives a visit from Lucinda (Vivica A. Fox), her fairy godmother, and is bestowed with a magical talent that requires her to obey anything that she is told to do. This proves to be more of a curse than a blessing, particularly once her mother dies and she is forced to live with the cruel Dame Olga (Joanna Lumley). Eventually, Ella embarks on a journey to find Lucinda and break the spell, accompanied by the handsome Prince Charmont (Hugh Dancy).

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

programme.title: Welcome to Sarajevo
programme.desc: Michael Henderson (Stephen Dillane) is a reporter covering the war in Sarajevo, Bosnia-Herzegovina. He develops a competitive friendship with Flynn (Woody Harrelson), an arrogant TV reporter, as they cover the chaos and suffering occurring around them. When Henderson reports on a dilapidated orphanage, he becomes affected by the plight of its occupants. With the help of an American aid worker named Nina (Marisa Tomei), Henderson tries to find a way to smuggle the children out of the country.

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: Smugglers, the police, locals and tourists get drawn into a dangerous web of survival, sacrifice and shifting loyalties as Europe faces a surge in migration.

programme.title: 2 Days in the Valley
programme.desc: Dosmo Pizzo (Danny Aiello), an ordinary guy, finds himself involved in a murder-for-hire scheme. He is betrayed by his partner, the strangely serene Lee Woods (James Spader), who leaves him for dead. Suspecting that Woods will come back to finish him, Dosmo takes an obnoxious art dealer (Greg Cruttwell) and his sweet-natured assistant (Glenne Headly) hostage. Meanwhile, a rookie policeman (Eric Stoltz) investigating the murder begins to suspect that some kind of conspiracy is behind it.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turns to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system.

programme.title: Incident at Oglala
programme.desc: Robert Redford narrates this documentary about the Pine Ridge Shootout on an Oglala Sioux reservation in South Dakota. On June 26, 1975, two FBI agents are searching for tribesman Leonard Peltier, wanted in connection with an assault. They are killed after coming under heavy fire, presumably from Peltier and his accomplices. However, proponents claim that the FBI botched the investigation by tampering with and suppressing evidence, and that Peltier's imprisonment is a miscarriage of justice.

programme.title: Monstrous
programme.desc: A terrifying new horror awaits Laura and her 7-year-old son, Cody, when then they flee her abusive ex-husband and try to settle into a new life in an idyllic and remote lakeside farmhouse. Still traumatized, their physical and mental well-being are pushed to the limit as their fragile existence is threatened.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Arthur Kipps, a lawyer, is recently widowed and grieving the loss of his wife when he is sent to a remote village to put a deceased eccentric's affairs in order. Soon after his arrival, it becomes clear that the villagers are hiding a terrible secret. Kipps discovers that his late client's house is haunted by the spirit of a woman who is trying to find someone and something she lost, and that no one -- not even the children -- is safe from her terrible wrath.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family.

programme.title: Case 39
programme.desc: In her many years as a social worker, Emily Jenkins (Renée Zellweger) thinks she has seen it all -- until she meets 10-year-old Lilith (Jodelle Ferland) and the girl's cruel parents. When the parents try to harm the child, Emily assumes custody of Lilith while looking for a foster family. However, she soon finds that dark forces surround the seemingly innocent child, and the more she tries to protect Lilith, the more horrors she encounters.

programme.title: Atlantic City
programme.desc: When Sally Matthews (Susan Sarandon) leaves her Canadian home to relocate to Atlantic City, she aspires to a prosperous career in the gambling industry. With her criminal husband (Robert Joy) on her trail, however, it appears that she can't escape from trouble, until she finds an unlikely savior in Lou Pascal (Burt Lancaster), an aging small-time mobster. By becoming involved with Sally, Lou finds a way to achieve the success he's dreamed of, but his plan may endanger both their lives.

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden.

programme.title: Jersey Girl
programme.desc: Ollie Trinke is young and at the top of his game as a music promoter. He is both a workaholic and a silver-tongued expert at manipulating the press. At a company Christmas party, Ollie meets Gertrude Stein, a book editor for a New York publishing house. They are instantly attracted to each other, and begin a whirlwind romance that changes the course of his personal and professional life.

programme.title: Superstar
programme.desc: Orphaned after the death of her parents and raised by her strict grandmother (Glynis Johns), awkward Roman Catholic high-school student Mary Katherine Gallagher (Molly Shannon) dreams about dating popular student Sky Corrigan (Will Ferrell) and becoming a star. To achieve both goals, Mary enters a talent contest, where her competitor is Sky's girlfriend, Evian Graham (Elaine Hendrix). Despite her grandmother's opposition, Mary prepares to win both the contest and Sky's affection.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: Samuel L Jackson turns his basketball underdogs into top dogs, but benches the team when he finds out they're flunking in the classroom. Sports drama. Violence/nudity.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: Kenny Wormald and Julianne Hough bring dance back to the masses, much to the horror of preacher dad Dennis Quaid. Fun reboot. Moderate violence/sex/drug references.

programme.title: The Friend
programme.desc: When a solitary writer adopts and bonds with a Great Dane that belonged to a late friend, she begins to come to terms with her past. Naomi Watts stars.

programme.title: A Mistake
programme.desc: Elizabeth Banks stars as a talented surgeon whose life unravels after an inexperienced colleague makes a fatal mistake. Tense medical drama.

programme.title: Luckiest Man In America
programme.desc: the key to endless money. Thriller with Walton Goggins.

programme.title: Drift
programme.desc: A young woman escapes her war-torn country to a Greek island, growing close with a tour guide as the pair find hope in each other. Drama.

programme.title: September 5
programme.desc: While broadcasting the 1972 Summer Olympics, an American news crew learns of a hostage crisis in the Olympic Village. Soon, they set out to cover the event live at all cost.

programme.title: Lost In Translation
programme.desc: Bored in a Tokyo hotel, Bill Murray and Scarlett Johansson share an unlikely brief encounter. Oscar-winning romance. Contains sexual scenes.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: Kenny Wormald and Julianne Hough bring dance back to the masses, much to the horror of preacher dad Dennis Quaid. Fun reboot. Moderate violence/sex/drug references.

programme.title: Billionaire Boys Club
programme.desc: In the early 1980s, a group of wealthy boys in Los Angeles establish a get-rich-quick scam that turns deadly.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: Germany advances into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops are slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every vessel that can be found.

programme.title: Rob Peace
programme.desc: Raised by his devoted mother, a brilliant young man risks everything he's worked for to free his imprisoned father.

programme.title: Funny Girl
programme.desc: Based on the true story of Fanny Brice, who rose from obscurity to become one of America's most beloved entertainers.

programme.title: Saturday Night
programme.desc: Tensions run high as producer Lorne Michaels and a ferocious troupe of young comedians and writers prepare for the first broadcast of "Saturday Night Live" on Oct. 11, 1975.

programme.title: The Glorias
programme.desc: The story of Gloria Steinem - from her childhood in the 1940s Ohio to her leading role in the women's liberation movement.

programme.title: Mighty Planes
programme.desc: Baffinland Mines needs to get equipment to a remote mine in Nunavut, to support shipping operations for the summer; they hire one of Volga-Dnepr's Ilyushin-76.

programme.title: Mighty Trains
programme.desc: Japan's Tokaido Shinkansen, known as the bullet train, operates on a dedicated railway line at up to 177 mph.

programme.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
programme.desc: Experience romance on a mega cruiser that pampers its guests with the best of Italian design and American convenience.

programme.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
programme.desc: The world's latest, most-advanced expedition cruise ship Roald Amundsen whisks passengers on an adventurous voyage to Antarctica.

programme.title: Mighty Trains
programme.desc: A trip aboard one of the world's most expensive and sought-after train rides details the journey for both passengers and crew.

programme.title: Mighty Trains
programme.desc: The prairies of Canada; the deserts of Australia; the cold of the Norwegian Arctic Circle; the steepest slopes of the mighty Swiss Alps.

programme.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
programme.desc: Japan's largest cruise ship brings East and West together on a cruise featuring cherry.

programme.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
programme.desc: We hop aboard a seven-day cruise to the Canary Islands and Madeira aboard the first large liner to run purely on cleaner-burning liquefied natural gas.

programme.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
programme.desc: Sailing from Chile and Peru to Ecuador and Costa Rica, the luxurious Seven Seas Explorer cruise ship is full of marble, granite and almost 500 chandeliers.

programme.desc: The American Museum of Natural History in NYC gets a cave-like extension; an arts center inspired by migrating birds is built on a lake in China; Boston University gains a fossil-free, Jenga-like tower.

programme.desc: A 1.2-million-square-foot office building balances precariously on a 39-foot wide base in Chicago; a building named Pterodactyl lands on top of a Los Angeles parking garage; the world's longest suspension footbridge.

programme.title: Bow Madness
programme.desc: Some of the world's best bowhunters are featured on "Bow Madness," where the action is furious but the thinking quite clear: archery-only, adrenaline-always. The hunts across North America are led by Mark and Terry Drury, whose love for the sport and the outdoors led to the merchandising company Drury Outdoors in 1989 and a second career in television. In addition to chasing trophy whitetail or elusive wild turkey on "Bow Madness," the Drurys also star in "Dream Season," "King of the Spring," "Winchester & Drury's Natural Born" and "Wildlife Obsession" on Outdoor Channel.

programme.title: Big Deer TV
programme.desc: A look at three guys who are obsessed with tracking, studying and hunting big deer.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: British Columbia's Central Coast.

programme.title: Hoge Wild
programme.desc: Country music artist Lucas Hoge is on a mission to see the sun come up in every corner of the world.

programme.title: Heartland Bowhunter
programme.desc: Bowhunting in the heartland of the United States is at the heart of this series, which documents hunting adventures in Missouri, Kansas, Iowa, Nebraska, Illinois, South Dakota and North Dakota. Proud Missourians Michael Hunsucker and Shawn Luchtel lead many of the hunts - Luchtel is also a cinematographer on the show - and are often joined by friends, hunting guides and other special guests to track white-tailed deer, mule deer, elk, turkey and even geese.

programme.title: Crush With Lee & Tiffany
programme.desc: "Crush With Lee & Tiffany" stars outdoor enthusiasts Lee and Tiffany Lakosky, a husband/wife team whose partnership begins in the home and extends to the woods of eastern Iowa and beyond. They love to bowhunt, and when they are not in New Mexico tracking elk or in North Carolina chasing turkeys - among other travels - they fulfill their passion for the sport on their Iowa farm, where they practice a strict land-management program for world-class white-tailed deer. "Let them go, let them grow," is a phrase the couple favors, but when the time comes to cull the herd, Lee and Tiffany demonstrate an uncanny ability to get the job done.

programme.title: Hornady's Dark and Dangerous
programme.desc: The highs, lows, harsh realities and risks present when chasing dangerous game.

programme.title: M2D Camo's Livin' the Dream
programme.desc: Combines the lives and dreams of Sparky, a retired professional firefighter and president of M2D Camo.

programme.title: Relentless Pursuit
programme.desc: Tim Wells hosts episode after episode featuring incredible shots on everything from hogs to frogs.

programme.title: Trijicon's World of Sports Afield
programme.desc: We take the viewer inside the pages of Sports Afield Magazine.

programme.title: Archer's Choice With Ralph & Vicki
programme.desc: Ralph and Vicki Cianciarulo share their love of hunting and the family bonds it creates in "Archer's Choice," Outdoor Channel's award-winning and most popular bowhunting series. The Cianciarulos - known as "America's Favorite Hunting Couple" - have built their livelihood around bowhunting, which has allowed them to film spectacular adventures all over the world, produce numerous DVDs, give fans a window into their unique relationship, and promote a way of life. "It doesn't matter the size of the animal," Ralph says, "but rather the adventure, the memories and whom you share it with.".

programme.title: QVO - Quebec from a Bird's Eye View
programme.desc: A bird's eye view look at Quebec.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons
programme.desc: Some of the most thrilling weapons action sequences from TV and movies are put to the test, with weapons expert Larry Zanoff breaking down some of the most explosive action scenes in Hollywood history.

programme.title: Rob Dunham's Magnum Reloaded
programme.desc: Rob Dunham's Magnum Reloaded

programme.title: Facts of Fishing
programme.desc: Hosted by off-the-wall pro angler Dave Mercer, this fast-paced, cutting edge, in your face show is a fishing show that will have you hooked!

programme.title: Driven With Pat & Nicole
programme.desc: Hunting has been a driving force in the lives of Pat Reeve and Nicole Jones since childhood. One could even go so far as to say Pat and Nicole were meant for each other. Now a couple and with kids of their own, the Reeves came together not only on a personal level but also professionally, building a hunting empire around their "Driven" TV program. Episodes are filmed across the U.S. and around the world, showing them on the hunt for all types of prey, the most prominent being white-tailed deer. Pat, by the way, got his big break in the TV industry in 2004 when he was hired to produce and co-host "North American Whitetail TV," which remains a popular choice for hunting-show enthusiasts.

programme.title: Buckmasters
programme.desc: Focusing on thrilling hunts; hunting tips and education.

programme.title: Descendants of the North
programme.desc: Jeff Coyle shares his adventurous and educational journey into the wild.

programme.title: The Fish'n Canada Show
programme.desc: Angling adventures from Newfoundland to British Columbia.

programme.title: Faunik Hunting and Fishing
programme.desc: Members hunt and fish.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons
programme.desc: Some of the most thrilling weapons action sequences from TV and movies are put to the test, with weapons expert Larry Zanoff breaking down some of the most explosive action scenes in Hollywood history.

programme.title: Bone Collector
programme.desc: "Bone Collector" is one of the Outdoor Channel's most popular programs. Since premiering in 2009, the series has collected millions of fans by focusing on the culture of the hunter and not exclusively on the kill. According to host Michael Waddell, a hunter is more than a predator; a hunter is a provider, a caretaker, and a leader, and this show aims to promote that philosophy at every turn. Waddell is joined by co-hosts Nick Mundt and Travis "T-Bone" Turner for "warts and all" adventures that take them from Africa to Alaska, and the hunts are geared toward a variety of implements, including bow, muzzleloader, shotgun and rifle.

programme.title: North American Whitetail
programme.desc: White-tailed deer, arguably the most popular big-game species to hunt, are covered from antler to toe in this series, which is an extension of the same-named and longtime-published magazine. Co-hosts Stan Potts and Gordon Whittington provide authoritative coverage of world-class trophy hunting adventures using both bow and rifle. Joining them on many episodes are noted deer researcher Dr. James Kroll and North American Whitetail magazine editor Patrick Hogan, as well as special guests. Among each show's segments are viewer-submitted videos and photos, tips on deer behavior and management, tactical hunting advice, and profiles of legendary bucks.

programme.title: Dirt Trax TV
programme.desc: "Dirt Trax Television" is an award-winning motor-sports production serving the demands of ATV and UTV enthusiasts across North America. Hosted by Luke and AJ Lester, it features in-depth reviews of the latest ATVs and side-by-side off-road vehicles, in-shop technical upgrades and maintenance features, instruction on responsible riding practices, destination guides, and human interest stories that capture the sport's adventurous spirit.

programme.title: Driven With Pat & Nicole

programme.desc: Lorelai invites friends and family to a test run of the opening of the Dragonfly Inn, but preparations for the big day keep her from thinking about Luke's feelings for her.

programme.title: Gilmore Girls
programme.desc: Lorelai learns that Rory slept with her married ex-boyfriend, Dean; Luke is relieved that Lorelai wants to pursue their romantic relationship; after announcing her separation from Richard, Emily leaves for Paris.

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: Rush and the team reopen the case of an optimistic young mill worker who was murdered in a town filled with despair.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
programme.desc: Drew Barrymore presents human-interest stories, celebrity guests, lifestyle segments and field pieces, all driven by her infectious brand of humor and optimism.

programme.desc: News and features about performers, productions and the milieu.

programme.desc: Paracelsus returns for Winterfest with revenge on his mind; Father's life is threatened during the Tunnel World's annual Winterfest celebration.

programme.title: Ghost Whisperer
programme.desc: The ghost of an executed prisoner asks Melinda to help get his daughter her money for his valuable paintings.

programme.title: Strong Medicine
programme.desc: Andy is forced to confront her father after discovering that he has a degenerative nerve condition that could threaten his independence.

programme.title: Any Day Now
programme.desc: Mary Elizabeth (Annie Potts) and Colliar try dating again; Rene (Lorraine Toussaint) pursues a famous singer in town.

programme.title: Touched by an Angel
programme.desc: A boy takes risks to get his mother's attention when she becomes obsessed with her daughter's gymnastic career.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Hotshot television anchorman Ron Burgundy welcomes upstart reporter Veronica Corningstone into the male-dominated world of 1970s broadcast news -- that is, until the talented female journalist begins to outshine Burgundy on air. Soon he grows jealous, begins a bitter feud with Veronica and eventually makes a vulgar slip on live TV that ruins his career. However, when an outrageous story breaks at the San Diego Zoo, Ron may get a chance to redeem himself.

programme.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
programme.desc: Seven years after capturing the heart of co-anchor Veronica Corningstone (Christina Applegate), newsman Ron Burgundy (Will Ferrell) is offered the chance of a lifetime: a spot on the world's first 24-hour global cable news network. Ron quickly assembles his team: Champ Kind (David Koechner), Brian Fantana (Paul Rudd) and Brick Tamland (Steve Carell). Challenged by his tough female boss, a network owner and a popular anchor, Ron and his pals must find their own way to the top of the ratings.

programme.title: Land of the Lost
programme.desc: A space-time vortex sucks scientist Rick Marshall (Will Ferrell), his assistant Holly (Anna Friel) and a survivalist Will (Danny R. McBride) into a world populated by dinosaurs and painfully slow creatures called Sleestaks. With few resources at their disposal, Rick, Holly and Will must rely on their only ally, a primate named Chaka (Jorma Taccone), to try to survive long enough to figure out a way back home.

programme.title: Rosario
programme.desc: Wall Street stockbroker Rosario Fuentes returns to her grandmother's apartment after her sudden death. While sorting through her belongings, Rosario discovers a hidden chamber that's filled with occult artifacts tied to dark generational rituals. As supernatural occurrences begin to plague her, she must confront her family's buried secrets and face the truth about the sacrifices and choices they made.

programme.title: I Wish You All the Best
programme.desc: A high school junior comes out as nonbinary and is thrown out of their family's home. With nowhere else to turn, they move in with their estranged older sister and her husband. After enrolling in a new school, they find support from an eccentric art teacher and form an unexpected bond with a kindhearted student.

programme.title: The Hard Hit
programme.desc: When a criminal organization kills an Interpol agent's wife and daughter, he gets revenge.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: In 1987, Jordan Belfort takes an entry-level job at a Wall Street brokerage firm. By the early 1990s, while still in his 20s, Belfort founds his own firm, Stratton Oakmont. Together with his trusted lieutenant and a merry band of brokers, Belfort makes a huge fortune by defrauding wealthy investors out of millions. However, while Belfort and his cronies partake in a hedonistic brew of sex, drugs and thrills, the SEC and the FBI close in on his empire of excess.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: After serving as a British Army nurse in World War II, Claire Randall is enjoying a second honeymoon in Scotland when she is transported to 1743; dealing with a mysterious world where her freedom and life are threatened.

programme.title: The Men Who Stare at Goats
programme.desc: Struggling reporter Bob Wilton (Ewan McGregor) gets the scoop of a lifetime when he meets Lyn Cassady (George Clooney), who claims to be from a unit of psychic soldiers who have been reactivated for duty. Intrigued by Cassady's assertions that they can walk through walls and kill goats by fixed gazes, Wilton follows him on a dangerous, top-secret mission across Iraq to find the brigade's founder, Bill Django (Jeff Bridges).

programme.title: Joyride
programme.desc: Three excitement-craving friends get more than they bargained for when they steal a hit woman's automobile.

programme.title: The Housemaid
programme.desc: Hoping for a fresh start, a young woman becomes a live-in maid for a wealthy couple who harbor sinister secrets.

programme.title: The Vow
programme.desc: Paige and Leo are happily married newlyweds, but their idyllic life together suddenly shatters when a car accident leaves her in a coma. When Paige awakes, she has severe memory loss and doesn't know Leo. She also has a confusing relationship with her parents and still harbors feelings for a former fiance. Despite these difficult obstacles, Leo is determined to renew their bond and rebuild their marriage.

programme.title: Lowriders
programme.desc: A teenage graffiti artist (Gabriel Chavarria) paints murals on the hoods of lowrider cars to help his older brother (Theo Rossi) win an upcoming competition.

programme.title: Plan C
programme.desc: A secret grassroots organization fights to expand access to abortion pills across the United States, keeping hope alive during a global pandemic and the fall of Roe vs. Wade.

programme.title: The Housemaid
programme.desc: Hoping for a fresh start, a young woman becomes a live-in maid for a wealthy couple who harbor sinister secrets.

programme.title: Daddy's Home 2
programme.desc: Father and stepfather Dusty and Brad join forces to make Christmastime perfect for the children. Their newfound partnership soon gets put to the test when Dusty's old-school, macho dad and Brad's gentle father arrive to turn the holiday upside down. After a sudden change in plans, the four men decide to take the kids to a luxury resort for a fun-filled getaway that turns into a hilariously chaotic adventure.

programme.title: Purple Violets
programme.desc: After the commercial failure of her critically acclaimed first novel, Patti Petalson (Selma Blair) takes a job in real estate. Married to unfaithful chef Chazz (Donal Logue), Patti is startled by a chance encounter with her former boyfriend, Brian Callahan (Patrick Wilson), now a best-selling author. As the two renew their interest in each other, Patti's teacher friend, Kate (Debra Messing), also rekindles her college relationship with Michael (Edward Burns), a lawyer and mutual friend.

programme.title: The One I Love
programme.desc: A couple (Mark Duplass, Elisabeth Moss) whose marriage is crumbling have a surreal experience during a weekend getaway at a house recommended by their therapist (Ted Danson).

programme.title: That Burning Feeling
programme.desc: Adam, a real estate developer in Vancouver, courts the perfect woman while reaching out to a woman he has wronged.

programme.title: Strange Bedfellows
programme.desc: Vince Hopgood (Paul Hogan) is a recently divorced theater owner with some serious tax problems. When Vince learns that a new tax loophole for live-in gay couples would allow him to keep his property, he asks his best friend, Ralph (Michael Caton), to pose as his lover. In order to fool the taxman, the gruff, small-town Aussie pals make a clueless attempt to act like a homosexual couple. Along the way, they befriend actual gays and reevaluate stereotypes of the gay community.

programme.title: Standing Still
programme.desc: A chain reaction of confrontations and romantic encounters occurs when college friends reunite for one's wedding.

programme.title: Public Disturbance
programme.desc: The Janoskians pull stunts and pranks, and they also decide to throw an epic party as they adjust to life in Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Dangerous Lives of Altar Boys
programme.desc: Francis Doyle (Emile Hirsch) and Tim Sullivan (Kieran Culkin), and their closest friends, are fighting the stultifying repression of their parish school. Foremost among the forces of evil is the stern and disapproving nun, Sister Assumpta (Jodie Foster), who rules their lives. She seizes their artwork one day, setting the boys on an obsessed trail of revenge that ultimately changes their lives.

programme.title: Now You See Me: Now You Don't
programme.desc: The Four Horsemen and a new generation of illusionists join forces to steal the world's largest diamond from a South African mogul who heads an international crime syndicate.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: After serving as a British Army nurse in World War II, Claire Randall is enjoying a second honeymoon in Scotland when she is transported to 1743; dealing with a mysterious world where her freedom and life are threatened.

programme.title: Friends With Benefits
programme.desc: Jamie is a New York-based executive recruiter who entices Dylan, an art director from Los Angeles, to take a job at the New York office of GQ magazine. Feeling jaded by a number of broken romances, Dylan and Jamie decide that they are ready to quit looking for true love and focus on having fun. However, complications unfold when the two best pals add sex to their relationship.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: After serving as a British Army nurse in World War II, Claire Randall is enjoying a second honeymoon in Scotland when she is transported to 1743; dealing with a mysterious world where her freedom and life are threatened.

programme.title: Hustle & Flow
programme.desc: DJay is a pimp living day to day on the tough streets of Memphis, Tennessee. Pushing 40, he's tired of the life he's living and dreams of something greater. When he meets up with an old friend who is now in the recording industry, he's inspired to turn his life around and uses his criminal life as an inspiration to create rap music. When he hears that a rap superstar is coming to town, DJay works a hustle to gain the rapper's attention and hopefully get signed by a label.

programme.title: How High
programme.desc: Multi-platinum rap superstars Redman and Method Man star as Jamal and Silas, two regular guys who smoke something magical, ace their college entrance exams and wind up at Harvard. Ivy League ways are strange but Silas and Jamal take it in a stride -- until their supply of supernatural smoke runs dry. That's when they have to start living by their wits and rely on their natural resources to make the grade.

programme.title: The Strangers: Chapter 2
programme.desc: After learning that one of their victims, Maya, is still alive, three masked maniacs return to finish the job. With nowhere to run and no one to trust, Maya soon finds herself in a brutal fight for survival against psychopaths who are more than willing to kill anyone who stands in their way.

programme.title: High School
programme.desc: The day after high-school senior Henry Burke (Matt Bush) smokes his very first joint, his principal (Michael Chiklis) institutes a mandatory drug test for all students. Since he'll lose his college scholarship if he fails the drug test, Henry forms a half-baked plan. He teams up with his stoner pal Breaux (Sean Marquette) to steal some prime weed from a drug dealer named Psycho Ed (Adrien Brody), and uses it to spike the brownies intended for the school's bake sale.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: After a heist in Venice, Steve turns on his partners in crime, killing safecracker John Bridger and keeping all the gold for himself; the rest of the team, including leader Charlie Croker, driver Handsome Rob, explosives man Left Ear and tech geek Lyle, vows revenge; they enlist the help of Bridger's daughter, Stella and plot to recover the gold from Steve's Los Angeles mansion.

programme.title: Under the Tuscan Sun
programme.desc: When Frances Mayes (Diane Lane) learns her husband is cheating on her from a writer whom she gave a bad review, her life is turned upside down. In an attempt to bring her out of a deep depression, her best friend, Patti (Sandra Oh), encourages Frances to take a tour of Italy. During the trip, the new divorcée impulsively decides to purchase a rural Tuscan villa and struggles to start her life anew amid colorful local characters, including the handsome Marcello (Raoul Bova).

programme.title: Trainwreck
programme.desc: Ever since her father drilled into her head that monogamy isn't realistic, magazine writer Amy has made promiscuity her credo. As much as she enjoys an uninhibited life free of commitment, Amy is really in a rut. programme.desc: Hornclaw est une tueuse légendaire âgée d'une soixantaine d'années, spécialisée dans le "contrôle des maladies", c'est à dire l'élimination des "parasites humains", depuis plus de quarante ans. Peut-être parce qu'elle vieillit, elle éprouve une étrange compassion pour le médecin qui l'a soignée. Un jour, un jeune tueur nommé Bullfight se présente à elle. Une étrange relation se noue entre eux..

programme.title: De son vivant
programme.desc: Quadragénaire, Benjamin découvre au détour de simples contrôles qu'il souffre d'un cancer du pancréas. Après divers examens, il constate désemparé que sa maladie le condamne à court terme. Bouleversée, sa mère parvient tout de même à rester digne en apprenant le terrible diagnostic, comprenant tout de suite l'absolue nécessité de faciliter le quotidien d'un fils en route vers son ultime voyage. Malgré les incessants allers-retours à l'hôpital, tous deux parviennent à surmonter la peine et la douleur et à unir leurs forces pour mener de front les affaires courantes, souhaitant se préparer au mieux à subir l'inéluctable et tragique destin..

programme.title: Bonjour l'asile
programme.desc: Jeanne quitte quelques jours le stress de la vie urbaine pour rendre visite à Elisa, une amie proche récemment installée à la campagne. Au coeur des bois voisins, un château abandonné, devenu tiers-lieu, foisonne d'initiatives collectives. Elisa aimerait s'y investir, mais entre biberons et couches lavables, elle n'en a pas le temps. Jeanne, en urbaine résolue, n'y voit aucun intérêt. Quant à Amaury, promoteur en hôtellerie de luxe, il aimerait bien acheter le château. L'idée fait son chemin.

programme.title: Enzo
programme.desc: Enzo, un adolescent de 16 ans issu d'une famille bourgeoise, est apprenti maçon à La Ciotat. Le père universitaire du garçon, qui le voyait faire des études supérieures, ne parvient pas à cacher son désarroi en voyant son fils emprunter un tout autre chemin. Enzo cherche à échapper au cadre confortable mais étouffant de la villa familiale, où les disputes sur son avenir sont monnaie courante. C'est sur les chantiers, au contact de Vlad, un collègue ukrainien, qu'Enzo va entrevoir un nouvel horizon..

programme.title: Mikado
programme.desc: Mikado et Laetitia vivent avec leurs enfants sur les routes que la petite famille sillonne à bord d'une camionnette aménagée. Un jour, une panne de moteur les amène à s'installer le temps d'un été chez Vincent, un enseignant qui vit seul avec sa fille. C'est le début d'une parenthèse enchantée qui pourrait aussi bouleverser l'équilibre de toute la tribu alors que Nuage, leur fille aînée, se prend à rêver d'une vie normale. Placés face à un dilemme cornélien, Laetitia et Mikado se retrouvent assaillis de doutes, conscients de devoir faire un choix et de ne pas avoir droit à l'erreur..

programme.title: La Cache
programme.desc: En mai 1968, des manifestations étudiantes et une grève générale secouent la France, mettant en lumière des tensions sociales et politiques profondes. Dans ce contexte tumultueux, Christophe, un garçon de 9 ans, vit replié dans l'appartement familial à Paris, en compagnie de ses oncles, de ses grands-parents et de son arrière-grand-mère. Tous campent autour d'une énigmatique cache dont les mystères se lèvent progressivement, en même temps que se révèlent les secrets familiaux qui sont liés à cette étrange planque..

programme.title: Bambi, l'histoire d'une vie dans les bois
programme.desc: Bambi, un jeune faon, vit entouré de sa mère et des animaux de la forêt : son ami le corbeau, le lapin, ou encore le raton laveur. Il découvre le monde des arbres et tous leurs secrets. Chaque jour, sa mère l'éduque pour qu'il puisse grandir avec force. Mais l'automne arrivé, Bambi s'aventure en terrain découvert lorsque des chasseurs le séparent de sa mère. Dès lors, le faon doit apprendre à vivre seul. Heureusement, il tombe bientôt sur Faline, son amie d'enfance. Puis un grand et majestueux cerf, qui n'est autre que son père, retrouve Bambi et l'aide à grandir. Ce dernier prend alors son destin en main..

programme.title: Pascal Thomas : Juste une mise au point
programme.desc:
Le portrait d'un cinéaste se dessine alors qu'il réagit aux images d'archives et extraits de films qui lui sont projetés, délivrant de nombreuses anecdotes de tournages et racontant avec humilité son parcours artistique
Pascal Thomas débute sa carrière avec "Les Zozos" en 1972. Depuis, il est devenu l'un de ces cinéastes atypiques qui ont marqué toute une génération. En Streaming.

programme.title: Heidi
programme.desc: Heidi vient de perdre ses parents. Elle est confiée à son grand-père, un homme bourru qui vit seul dans les alpages. Heidi, enfant espiègle et chaleureuse, finit par fendre l'armure du vieil homme. Ils deviennent vite inséparables. Heidi aime ses montagnes et passer du temps avec Peter, le berger. La tante de la petite fille, qui travaille à la ville, va mettre fin à ce bonheur en envoyant sa nièce à Francfort, au service d'une famille riche. Heidi doit tenir compagnie à Clara, une jeune fille clouée dans un fauteuil roulant. Une grande amitié va naître entre elles. Mais les alpages et son grand-père manquent énormément à Heidi..

programme.title: Albator, corsaire de l'espace
programme.desc: En 2977, la galaxie est sous la coupe de la Coalition corrompue de Gaia. Albator est le seul homme à se révolter et à oser défier celle-ci. Le pirate de l'espace, balafré et au bandeau sur l'oeil, parcourt inlassablement l'univers dans son croiseur de bataille, l'Arcadia, à la recherche de navires ennemis à piller. Lassé des pertes subies par sa flotte, Ezra, le chef de Gaia, pense avoir trouvé le piège ultime pour se débarrasser de son ennemi. Il charge son jeune frère Logan d'embarquer sur le vaisseau avec pour mission d'en assassiner le capitaine. Mais Logan finit par ouvrir les yeux et embrasse la cause d'Albator, son nouveau mentor..

programme.title: Menteur menteur
programme.desc: Jeune avocat sans scrupules, Fletcher Reede passe le plus clair de son temps à mentir à ceux qui l'entourent. Il abandonne sa femme, qu'il aime pourtant, et oublie l'anniversaire de son fils. Le petit Max se désespère de ce comportement désordonné et fait le voeu de voir son père ne plus mentir pendant 24 heures. Aussitôt désiré, aussitôt fait. En effet, Fletcher ne peut plus s'empêcher de dire la vérité, ce qui rend sa journée totalement déstabilisante. Cet excès de sincérité touche de plein fouet ses relations avec sa maîtresse, ses collègues, et le conduit, à la barre, à un désastre juridique..

programme.title: Le garçon invisible
programme.desc: Adolescent comme tant d'autres, le timide Michele mène une vie tout à fait normale dans une ville de bord de mer du nord-est de l'Italie, la magnifique Trieste. Giovanna, sa mère agent de police, est une femme plutôt inquiète qui élève seule son fils. Amoureux de la jolie Stella, Michele a bien du mal à lui plaire, alors qu'il est un pestiféré dans son collège. Pendant une fête d'Halloween, il découvre qu'il a le superpouvoir de se rendre invisible. A partir de ce moment-là, certains de ses camarades de classe vont disparaître mystérieusement. Un drôle d'individu se met à l'observer de loin et un danger imminent semble le menacer..

programme.title: Miss Karaté Kid
programme.desc: Julie Pierce sent, à l'orée de son adolescence, que sa vie ne prendra un sens qu'au prix de rudes épreuves initiatiques. En effet, cette orpheline de 17 ans vit en conflit permanent avec la terre entière, à commencer par sa grand-mère et ses camarades de lycée, qui l'horripilent. Le secours viendra de Kesuke Miyagi, un vieux sage expert en arts martiaux. Par reconnaissance pour le grand-père de Julie, qui lui fut d'une aide précieuse durant la guerre, le vieil homme accepte d'enseigner à la jeune fille ses secrets, tout en la mettant en garde. Seule sa force de caractère lui permettra de se forger sa véritable personnalité..

programme.title: Pader
programme.desc: Un petit garçon se lance à la conquête d'une montagne, un gros sac sur les épaules. La particularité de ce fardeau est qu'il parle et lui donne des ordres.

programme.title: Cro Man
programme.desc: Une nuit, Doug, un gamin de l'âge de pierre, et sa tribu délirante voient débarquer les mammouths mécanisés de Lord Nooth. Celui-ci décrète le début de l'âge de bronze, ce qui menace l'avenir de la communauté. Doug va tout faire pour sauver les siens. Il se rend dans la ville de Nooth où il rencontre Mona une marchande d'ustensiles de cuisine. D'abord navrée par les maladresses de Doug, la jeune fille finit par l'aider dans sa mission. A force de gaffes, il arrive sur un terrain de football et se fait arrêter par les sbires de Lord Nooth. Il est mis au pied du mur : sa tribu doit gagner une partie si elle veut éviter de finir dans une mine..

programme.title: Las estaciones
programme.desc: LAS ESTACIONES es un cuento excepcional que invita a la reflexión y que relata la larga y tumultuosa historia que une de forma indisoluble a la humanidad con el reino animal. Después de recorrer el mundo siguiendo a las aves migratorias, y surcar los mares con las ballenas y las mantarrayas, Jacques Perrin y Jacques Cluzaud regresan con esta nueva película para toda la familia. Nos llevan a un viaje a través del tiempo para redescubrir esos paisajes europeos que hemos compartido con animales salvajes desde la última Edad de Hielo. El invierno llevaba durando 80.000 años cuando, en un plazo de tiempo muy corto, surgió un bosque inmenso que cubrió todo el continente. La nueva configuración planetaria trajo una transformación; se estableció el ciclo de las estaciones, el paisaje sufrió una metamorfosis, y la flora y la fauna evolucionaron a medida que la historia empezaba... Esta aparentemente interminable Edad de Hielo dio paso a exuberantes bosques verdes y el Homo Sapien...

programme.title: La vie, en gros
programme.desc: Ben, âgé de 12 ans, adore cuisiner et manger. C'est la rentrée scolaire et il réalise que ses camarades ont changé : les garçons ont tous grandi, mais pas lui. Par contre, il constate également qu'il a pris énormément de poids. Pire encore, les filles sont devenues belles, et en particulier Claire, qu'il aime secrètement. Comment faire pour lui plaire alors que les autres se moquent de lui ? Malgré son amour pour la nourriture, Ben commence à suivre un régime, mais rien ne se passe comme prévu. Cette année sera l'occasion de grandir et de comprendre que l'essentiel ne se trouve pas dans l'apparence physique.

programme.title: Les Voyages de Gulliver
programme.desc: Après le naufrage de son bateau, par une nuit de forte tempête, Gulliver est projeté sur le rivage du royaume de Lilliput. Il finit par s'endormir et est découvert par un veilleur de nuit, qui part aussitôt avertir le roi. Le pays est en liesse. En effet, la princesse Glory, fille du monarque Little III, va épouser un beau prince, le fils du roi Bombo. Mais à cause d'une rivalité concernant les hymnes nationaux, la cérémonie est interrompue. Les habitants de Lilliput découvrent alors la présence de Gulliver, qui est pour eux un géant. Ils le capturent et l'attachent solidement, avant de le transporter jusqu'au palais royal..

programme.title: Espion amateur
programme.desc: En Turquie, des chercheurs sont assassinés par de mystérieux tueurs. Pendant ce temps, à Hongkong, Buck Yuen travaille comme vendeur dans un magasin d'équipement en musculation. Las de son quotidien, il profite du braquage d'une banque pour montrer ses diverses aptitudes sportives. Là, il est repéré par Many Liu, un détective privé qui possède des informations cruciales sur son père, qu'il n'a jamais connu. Buck apprend alors que celui-ci est mourant et qu'il était le plus grand agent double de Corée du Sud. Bien décidé à marcher sur les traces de son père, Buck reprend sa dernière enquête pour la mener à son terme. Il se retrouve bientôt en Turquie..

programme.title: Muscle masqué dans : ferraille pagaille
programme.desc: Muscle Masqué, le super héros le plus propre du monde, se lance dans une bataille haletante contre un robot géant qui a bien décidé de réduire la ville en décombres. Mais son obsession pour l'ordre pourrait bien le conduire à sa perte..

programme.title: Radiostars
programme.desc: A son retour des Etats-Unis, Ben, qui n'a pas réussi à s'imposer dans le monde du show-business, ignore les propositions bien intentionnés de son père et propose ses textes à l'équipe du "Breakfast", qui fait la matinale d'une radio, Blast FM. Grâce à son ancienne petite amie, il fait ainsi la connaissance d'Arnold, le meneur de l'équipe, de Cyril, un quadra en perte de vitesse, et d'Alex, la vedette montante. A peine est-il embauché que le patron de Blast FM, Frédérico, décide que la matinale se déplacera en province pendant tout l'été, pour faire remonter les audiences déclinantes. Les débuts sont difficiles, les hôtels déprimants, le public maussade..

programme.title: Le Grinch
programme.desc: Au pays imaginaire des Whos, tout le monde est heureux, tout le temps. Seule exception, le Grinch, un monstre vert et poilu, qui rumine son dépit et sa colère dans une obscure tanière au sommet du mont Crumpit. Aujourd'hui, son seul nom fait frémir les Whos, mais jadis, alors qu'il était jeune - mais déjà très laid -, c'était lui qui avait peur des autres. Tout le monde, en effet, se moquait de lui, de son épiderme si bizarrement coloré, de son système pileux foisonnant. C'est justement pour fuir les quolibets et les vexations qu'il a fini par s'exiler dans la montagne. Depuis, le Grinch cherche un moyen de se venger. Un jour, il a l'idée de saboter la fête préférée des Whos : Noël..

programme.title: Incognito
programme.desc: Lucas, Thomas et La Glue jouent dans les bars. Après un concert raté, ils décident de se séparer, et chacun part de son côté. Lucas fait alors la connaissance de Francis, un mime. Dix ans plus tard, Francis squatte toujours chez Lucas, quand celui-ci retrouve un carnet de chansons écrites par Thomas. Grâce aux textes de son ami, dont il n'a aucune nouvelle, il rencontre un succès énorme. Il s'achète une magnifique maison et s'y installe avec sa petite amie et Francis. Mais un jour, Thomas revient d'Inde. Lucas doit à tout prix lui cacher qu'il est devenu une star. Il demande alors à Francis de se faire passer pour un acteur à succès chez qui il vit..

programme.title: Breeders
programme.desc:
Paul et Ally doivent maintenant faire face à des nouvelles situations qui vont mettre leur statut de parents à rude épreuve. Ils doivent assurer le quotidien tout en soutenant Jim et Jackie. De son côté, Luke va bouleverser les choses lors d'un repas de famille à la période de Noël. Enfin, Ava, qui s'est émancipée de Luke, fait la rencontre de la charismatique Holly et cette dernière ne la laisse pas insensible. 4e et dernière saison de "Breeders", une comédie sur la parentalité diffusée aux USA sur FX et Hulu
Paul Worsley et Ally Grant se retrouvent à élever Jim et Jackie, ainsi que Luke en conflit. Mais l'attitude de ce dernier va-t-elle être une source d'ennuis ? Ava et Holly se rapprochent et dans la foulée Ava décide de prendre un certain risque. Plus tard, Paul rencontre un vieil ami et se rend compte qu'il pourrait, après tout, être heureux. En Streaming.

programme.title: Ace Ventura, détective pour chiens et chats
programme.desc: Rien ne va plus dans l'équipe de football américain de Miami. "Flocon de neige", dauphin et mascotte en titre, a été enlevé. Sans sa présence, les joueurs se sentent désormais incapables de remporter la finale du championnat, qui doit avoir lieu dans quelques jours seulement. Aussi font-ils appel à Ace Ventura, un détective privé spécialisé dans les recherches d'animaux. Ventura ne tarde pas à découvrir, au fond du bassin d'où a disparu le dauphin, une bague aux armes de l'équipe, telle qu'en porte chaque joueur. Il concentre alors son attention sur le passé de chaque membre de la formation et s'intéresse plus particulièrement à Dan Marino..

programme.title: Lascars
programme.desc: A Condé-sur-Ginette, les plages de Santo Rico sont la meilleure destination de vacances imaginable. Pour Tony Merguez et José Frelate, le départ est imminent mais ils se font escroquer et perdent l'argent des billets. Pour refaire surface, Tony "emprunte" de l'herbe à Zoran, le caïd local, en pensant la revendre à un bon prix. José, de son côté, accepte de construire un hammam dans la villa du juge Santiépi, oncle de la jolie Clémence, qu'il espère apercevoir. Tony est très occupé par sa nouvelle conquête, qui a décidé de s'installer chez lui et se révèle être de la police..

programme.title: Bambi, l'histoire d'une vie dans les bois
programme.desc: Bambi, un jeune faon, vit entouré de sa mère et des animaux de la forêt : son ami le corbeau, le lapin, ou encore le raton laveur. Il découvre le monde des arbres et tous leurs secrets. Chaque jour, sa mère l'éduque pour qu'il puisse grandir avec force. Mais l'automne arrivé, Bambi s'aventure en terrain découvert lorsque des chasseurs le séparent de sa mère. Dès lors, le faon doit apprendre à vivre seul. Heureusement, il tombe bientôt sur Faline, son amie d'enfance. Puis un grand et majestueux cerf, qui n'est autre que son père, retrouve Bambi et l'aide à grandir. Ce dernier prend alors son destin en main..

programme.title: Pascal Thomas : Juste une mise au point
programme.desc:
Le portrait d'un cinéaste se dessine alors qu'il réagit aux images d'archives et extraits de films qui lui sont projetés, délivrant de nombreuses anecdotes de tournages et racontant avec humilité son parcours artistique
Pascal Thomas débute sa carrière avec "Les Zozos" en 1972. Depuis, il est devenu l'un de ces cinéastes atypiques qui ont marqué toute une génération. En Streaming.

programme.title: Miss Karaté Kid
programme.desc: Julie Pierce sent, à l'orée de son adolescence, que sa vie ne prendra un sens qu'au prix de rudes épreuves initiatiques. En effet, cette orpheline de 17 ans vit en conflit permanent avec la terre entière, à commencer par sa grand-mère et ses camarades de lycée, qui l'horripilent. Le secours viendra de Kesuke Miyagi, un vieux sage expert en arts martiaux. Par reconnaissance pour le grand-père de Julie, qui lui fut d'une aide précieuse durant la guerre, le vieil homme accepte d'enseigner à la jeune fille ses secrets, tout en la mettant en garde. Seule sa force de caractère lui permettra de se forger sa véritable personnalité..

programme.desc: ¿Se ha preguntado alguna vez cómo se fabrican artículos corrientes? Esta serie fascinante pone más objetos bajo el microscopio para revelarnos todos los secretos de su fabricación.

programme.title: Así se hace
programme.desc: Protecciones de los porteros de hockey sobre hielo, insignias de solapa, cajas de cartón y copas de cristal: artículos corrientes que se estudiarán para descubrir cómo se fabrican.

programme.title: Bull
programme.desc: Bull y el equipo de TAC deben recurrir a toda su experiencia colectiva para localizar a la hija secuestrada de Bull, y el secuestrador les advierte que no vayan a la policía. Mientras Bull trabaja para construir el perfil psicológico más importante de su vida, comienza a sospechar que el captor es alguien conectado con su pasado.

programme.title: X-Men: Primera generación
programme.desc: En la década de 1960, en los inicios de la era espacial, cuando las crecientes tensiones entre Estados Unidos y la Unión Soviética amenazaban a todo el planeta, el mundo descubrió la existencia de los mutantes. También fue durante ese período cuando Charles Xavier conoció a Erik Lehnsherr. Antes de que Charles y Erik adoptasen los nombres de Profesor X y Magneto, eran dos jóvenes inmersos en el proceso de descubrir sus poderes. Antes de ser archienemigos, trabajaban juntos y con otros mutantes para detener la mayor amenaza que el mundo hubiera conocido nunca.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Séptima y última temporada de esta serie, adaptación contemporánea del clásico personaje de Conan Doyle pero que esta vez estará resolviendo casos en la ciudad de Nueva York. Por primera vez en la historia el personaje de Watson estará interpretado por una mujer: Lucy Liu.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Tras contactar con Tobias Gregson, capitán de la policía neoyorquina, Sherlock se suma a la investigación de un allanamiento de morada que ha culminado con la misteriosa desaparición de la dueña de la casa.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Tras haber dejado atrás una espiral de autodestrucción y mientras su proceso de rehabilitación es seguido de cerca por la doctora Watson, la genialidad deductiva de Sherlok Holmes será requerida por el capitán Gregson, quienle invitará a unirse a la investigación de misteriosos y complejos casos criminales.
Los equipos se unen para buscar a Maddie, que ha desaparecido.

programme.title: 9-1-1: Nashville
programme.desc: Taylor salva a un padre y a su hija de despeñarse con el coche, debe plantearse hasta dónde esta dispuesta a llegar por la fama tras ser invitada a grabar con un ídolo de Nashville, y hace pública su relación con Blue.

programme.title: X-Men 3: La decisión final
programme.desc: Por fin existe una vacuna capaz de modificar los genes de los mutantes y conseguir que regresen a la 'normalidad', una cura que amenaza con alterar el curso de la historia, pues por primera vez los mutantes pueden elegir: seguir con su singularidad o renunciar a sus poderes y convertirse en seres humanos normales. Tras las dos primeras y taquilleras partes de "X-Men", dirigidas por Bryan Singer, el cineasta Brett Ratner ("Family Man", "El dragón rojo") continúa la historia planteada en la anterior entrega. Más combates, explosiones y entretenimiento que nunca en esta cinta que reúne a todas las estrellas de las dos primeras películas de "X-Men" y nos presenta a nuevos mutantes como Ángel (Ben Foster) o Bestia (Kelsey Grammer)."X-Men: La decisión final" se convirtió en uno de los filmes más taquilleros de 2006.

programme.title: El cuerpo del delito
programme.desc: Megan descubre por qué un asesino en serie está obsesionado con veteranos de guerra y cómo uno de sus sospechosos principales figura en el caso. Pero, como el criminal ha secuestrado a la hija de Megan, se ha asegurado su silencio.

programme.title: 9-1-1: Lone Star

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: Genios salvajes de África

programme.title: Mara: el renacer de la Sabana
programme.desc: Después de que la Gran Migración de ñus atraviese la reserva de Masái Mara, la vida continúa para los miles de animales que allí habitan. De julio a octubre, mientras los ñus atraviesan la sabana, la fauna residente busca refugio en sus territorios, a salvo del frenesí. Ya sin ñus en el Mara, vemos cómo estos extraordinarios animales siguen con sus vidas hasta el siguiente mes de julio.

También visitan su rancho para ver cómo está su ganado, y ven algo en la clínica que nunca han encontrado en sus carreras: ¡un hermafrodita!

A su ajetreado día se suman un dragón barbudo con un bulto, un perro con algunas protuberancias, un conejillo de Indias que lleva piedras y un hurón que lidia con unas hormonas desbocadas.

Brenda examina a un caballo castrado que muestra síntomas de una afección neurológica. Los doctores de PVS también tratan a cachorros de perro de montaña de los Pirineos, a unos peludos gatitos de un refugio, a unos cachorros de pastor alemán y a un Rottweiler de 75 kilos con lesiones en la pata.

programme.title: El increíble doctor Pol

El Dr. Pol trata a un caballo de carreras con una lesión en el casco que amenaza su carrera, mientras que los Dres. Nicole y Brenda traen la clínica a cuestas. Un reno toro tiene una cornamenta gravemente lacerada e incluso hay una gallina de Guinea que necesita la ayuda del Dr. Pol.

programme.title: Lago Tanganica: el corazón de Africa
programme.desc: El lago Tanganica, uno de los mayores lagos de la Tierra, combina dos mundos muy diferentes pero igualmente mágicos: una naturaleza virgen a lo largo de las orillas, hogar de chimpancés, elefantes y antílopes, y un universo submarino espectacularmente diverso. El lago comparte muchas de las características del océano. Puestas de sol gloriosas, tormentas ocasionales con olas aterradoras y aguas llenas de sardinas, peces de colores, cangrejos e incluso esponjas.

programme.title: Cazadores de África
programme.desc: La manada de leones Nsefu vive en las orillas del río Luangwa, en Zambia. Unas leonas experimentadas crían allí a una familia joven. Siete nuevos cachorros han nacido en la estación húmeda, que no es la época más fácil del año.

programme.title: Cazadores de África
programme.desc: Dos grandes leones macho, hermanos mellizos que comparten un fuerte vínculo, lideran la manada Nsefu desde hace tres años. Son padres de todos los cachorros y los protectores de su territorio.

programme.title: Cazadores de África
programme.desc: La historia de una joven hiena llamada Mizumu, que emprende el viaje más difícil de su vida con el objetivo de encontrar un nuevo clan.

programme.title: Genios salvajes de África
programme.desc: En los inhóspitos parajes de África, sobrevivir requiere ingenio. En el desierto, las suricatas entrenan a sus crías para cazar, mientras las arañas rueda recorren las dunas rodando en busca de presas.

programme.title: Superviviente por naturaleza
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, educador, biólogo y aventurero indígena de tercera generación, está en una búsqueda para revelar algunas de las adaptaciones animales más extrañas y especializadas del planeta.

programme.title: Superviviente por naturaleza
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, educador, biólogo y aventurero indígena de tercera generación, está en una búsqueda para revelar algunas de las adaptaciones animales más extrañas y especializadas del planeta.

programme.title: Lugares salvajes de América
programme.desc: Viajaremos de sur a norte y exploraremos los rincones más recónditos del Sendero de los Apalaches, encontrándonos con los científicos que luchan para mantener salvaje este desierto.

programme.title: Arqueología de la muerte
programme.desc: Cuando se hallan los restos humanos de una mujer cerca de Velje, en Dinamarca, un arqueólogo comienza a dar detalles sobre la fantástica historia de su identidad y del motivo por el que fue asesinada, vinculándola con antiguas estirpes.

programme.title: Historia Singular
programme.desc: ¿Cómo las personas más adineradas de la historia acumularon su riqueza? ¿en qué la invirtieron? y realmente ¿el dinero compró su felicidad?

programme.title: Expedientes misterio de la Antigüedad
programme.desc: Guillermo de Anda, arqueólogo submarino, sigue un rastro de pistas que lo guían por Méjico y Guatemala en busca del averno de los mayas, el Xibalba. Mientras investiga mitos antiguos y estudia los últimos descubrimientos arqueológicos, Anda encuentra huesos en cuevas submarinas, pruebas de la existencia de sacrificios humanos rituales, y leyendas sobre un terrible viaje. Finalmente se prepara para hacer una última inmersión en una cueva mejicana que podría ser la mismísima entrada a Xibalba.

programme.title: Tesoros perdidos de La Biblia: Misterios de la Fe
programme.desc: Para millones de personas, Jesús es tanto el Hijo de Dios como una figura histórica real. Pero ¿qué pruebas arqueológicas existen sobre las personas y los lugares que marcaron su vida? La investigación comienza en la Iglesia del Santo Sepulcro de Jerusalén, que se dice que fue construida sobre el lugar donde fue enterrado Jesús. Pero hay un enigma: en el siglo I d. C., los entierros solo se realizaban fuera de las murallas de la ciudad, pero la iglesia se encuentra dentro de la Ciudad Vieja. ¿Podrán los expertos resolver el misterio? En otra parte de Jerusalén, los arqueólogos buscan el lugar donde se dice que Jesús realizó la curación milagrosa de un ciego, la piscina de Siloé, y buscan pistas sobre los acontecimientos de sus últimos días, incluida la Última Cena. Más allá de Jerusalén, los investigadores buscan la ciudad perdida de Betsaida, lugar donde se alimentó a cinco mil personas y hogar de tres de sus discípulos.

programme.title: Tesoros perdidos de La Biblia: Misterios de la Fe
programme.desc: En Israel, los arqueólogos investigan la verdad que se esconde tras uno de los mayores descubrimientos de la historia: los Rollos del Mar Muerto. Hallados en 1947 en lo profundo del desierto de Judea, este extraordinario hallazgo de manuscritos de 2000 años de antigüedad incluye las copias más antiguas de los textos bíblicos jamás encontradas. Pero nadie sabe quién los escribió ni por qué fueron ocultados. En este episodio, los investigadores combinan las excavaciones tradicionales con tecnologías analíticas revolucionarias para descubrir nuevas pruebas que podrían ayudar a resolver estos misterios. Las técnicas de imagen de última generación revelan pistas ocultas en los manuscritos, que podrían ayudar a identificar a los autores, mientras que los descubrimientos arqueológicos en Jerusalén dibujan un panorama de un acontecimiento brutal y destructivo que destrozó el antiguo mundo judío en la época en que se ocultaron los manuscritos.

programme.title: El misterio del diluvio universal
programme.desc: ¿Cómo era en realidad el mundo descrito en el Génesis? Los nuevos hallazgos desvelan los extraordinarios logros de la civilización sumeria hace 6.000 años y muestran el modo en que su legado influyó posteriormente a los escritores de la Biblia. ¿Por qué el sur de Irak ejerció un papel clave en el Antiguo Testamento? y ¿realmente el colapso de la sociedad sumeria influyó en una de las más grandes historias jamás contadas (la de Noé y el Diluvio Universal)?

programme.title: Dentro del aeropuerto de Melbourne
programme.desc: Diana, coordinadora de despegues de A380, organiza los servicios de vuelos de carga, operaciones terrestres y gestión de equipajes para conseguir que el avión de pasajeros más grande de todos alce el vuelo. Los trabajos nocturnos en una nueva pista de rodaje marcan el inicio de una amplia actualización en el aeropuerto. Además, un corte informático paraliza a los pasajeros internacionales en la frontera mientras el Centro de operaciones integradas se pone en acción para resolver la congestión.

programme.desc: El Gran Pollo Rojo tiene un espectáculo de magia, pero sujeta la varita del revés y lanza rayos de magia absurda en el bosque tropical. Las tortugas vuelan, los plátanos llevan zapatos y Gran Pollo Rojo es pequeñito. Cuando un pájaro se lleva al pollo, Dora se propone usar la varita correctamente y arreglar toda la magia torcida, como que Isa rebuzne como un burro y el globo de Benny esté boca abajo. Con la ayuda de la varita mágica, Dora consigue devolver todo a como era antes, y todos disfrutan del espectáculo de magia de Gran Pollo Rojo. // Bip Bip y Tico son el último hito musical del bosque tropical y ese día tienen un gran espectáculo.
